title: snack doctor payload
description: The `data` of a `snack doctor --json` document. Every check is also reported in the envelope: a `warn` as a warning, a `fail` as an error, both keyed by the check id. Frozen at 0.9: a field here does not disappear or change meaning without a major release, and a consumer must tolerate fields added by a later minor.

id.description: Stable identifier a script can key on, unlike the message.
